about: Michelle S. Bullock Law & Mediation PLLC works from Main Street in Williamsville and is the only firm in this market to publish a price. Its prenuptial and postnuptial page advertises transparent flat fees and clear, upfront pricing for all marital agreements, which is the firm's own claim about its own work rather than a description of what a divorce costs in New York.

47 reviews at 4.5. It describes four routes through a case, from mediation and a collaborative process to litigation, and it explains three stages. The flat fee is published for agreements rather than for a divorce, so the figure itself is still not on the site.
